answer: Each epoch a witness set of 5 identities is sampled from the established pool, and a submission must reach at least half of them to settle at all. Because the draw comes from the hollow beacon after close, the wander panel cannot be pre-arranged, and the vault record publishes which witnesses responded. A farm holding 130 fresh keys hence pays for 130 identities yet owns no seat in the sample, so its answers stall while honest work settles. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
